settings.headline:
Small studio. Big ideas.
Shipped to your pocket.
settings.copy: Neon Forge is an independent app studio crafting focused, beautifully-built mobile and desktop apps — one product at a time, with the care only a small team can give.

trust_list.text: A studio, not an agency — no account managers
Every app designed and built in-house
We ship, then we keep improving

settings.title: Focused apps for
settings.intro: We don't chase trends. We pick a problem we care about and build the best possible answer to it — then we keep refining it for years.

features.title: Product design
features.text: We start with the why. Research, flows, and prototypes that make sure we build the right thing before we build it beautifully.

features.title: Native engineering
features.text: Swift and Kotlin, done properly. Fast, offline-first, and accessible — the way a native app should feel.

features.title: Desktop & web
features.text: From macOS utilities to web apps, we bring the same craft to every screen your product lives on.

features.title: Long-term care
features.text: Shipping is the start, not the finish. We maintain, update, and improve our apps for years after launch.

settings.title: From spark to

steps.title: Discover
steps.text: We dig into the problem, the people, and the market. A clear brief beats a clever guess every time.

steps.title: Design
steps.text: Flows, wireframes, and a polished visual direction. You see the product take shape before a line of code.

steps.title: Build
steps.text: Tight, iterative sprints. We ship a working build early and refine it with real feedback, not assumptions.

steps.title: Launch & grow
steps.text: App Store, marketing, and a roadmap. We stay on after launch to keep the product sharp and the users happy.

settings.note: Most projects go from brief to a live beta in 8–12 weeks. We keep the team small so decisions are fast and the quality stays high.

settings.title: Six people,
settings.intro: No freelancers, no outsourcing. Everyone you meet is a full-time part of the studio.

members.name: Mara Voss
members.bio: Started Neon Forge in her garage with one app and a stubborn belief that software can feel personal again.

members.name: Theo Lindgren
members.bio: Swift specialist who sweats the details — haptics, transitions, and the moments most people never notice.

members.name: Priya Raman
members.bio: Turns complex problems into interfaces that feel obvious. Believes restraint is the highest form of design.

members.name: Jon Bell
members.bio: Kotlin and Material, done right. Keeps our Android apps as polished as our iOS ones.

members.name: Sofia Marchetti
members.bio: The bridge between ideas and execution. Keeps the roadmap honest and the launches on time.

members.name: Dmitri Volkov
members.bio: Builds the services and web apps that power our products. Quietly keeps everything running.

settings.title: Have an idea?
settings.intro: Whether you want to work with us or just say hello, we'd love to hear from you. We reply to every message.

settings.blurb: An independent app studio crafting focused, beautifully-built mobile and desktop apps — one product at a time.
